heading.h2: Closing the loop between humans and agentic AI

lead: Agentic AI systems plan, delegate, and collaborate, yet they rarely see the higher-level concerns people care about, and people rarely see how agent teams reach their objectives. My research builds abstractions in both directions. Building this loop efficiently and effectively is, I believe, what is missing.
caption: Two states, Human and Agentic AI. MDE abstractions carry human concerns to agents; abstractions of agent collaboration carry behavior back to people. Building this loop efficiently and effectively is the missing piece.

steps.d: safety, intent, correctness, and organizational constraints, as people state them
the same concerns at the level people reason about, precise enough to check
checkable obligations between people, guardrails, and agents
checked composition of agent teams and the state they share
does the composed team still meet its concerns?
transcripts, tool calls, and executions, abundant but unreadable at scale
the few components whose interaction explains a symptom
which version, approval, and context produced a behavior
why an objective was or was not achieved, in terms people can check

cards.body: Safety, correctness, intent, and organizational constraints usually reach an agent as informal prose. I use model-driven engineering (models, contracts, and model transformations) so that agentic systems can be specified against these concerns and checked for them.

Transcripts, tool logs, and traces are abundant but unreadable at scale. I build abstractions (slices, typed hand-offs, provenance, and knowledge graphs) that explain how agent teams collaborate, where they break, and why an objective was or was not achieved.

Specifications without visibility cannot tell us whether they were honored; visibility without specifications gives us nothing to check against. The loop must be effective, with abstractions at the level people reason about yet precise enough to check. It must also be efficient enough to repeat whenever a team, prompt, or model changes.
